// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

// ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО: Enable viaIR = true, Enable optimization = true
// В Remix: Settings → Compiler →勾 Enable viaIR + Enable optimization

interface IERC20 {
    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
}

contract PolygonHybridAMM {
    bool private _locked;

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        require(!_locked, "Reentrant call");
        _locked = true;
        _;
        _locked = false;
    }

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyPoolX1(address tokenX) {
        require(poolX1[tokenX].exists, "Pool X1 does not exist");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyPoolX2(address tokenX) {
        require(poolX2[tokenX].exists, "Pool X2 does not exist");
        _;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Safe transfers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _safeTransfer(IERC20 token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = address(token).call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transfer.selector, to, amount)
        );
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "Transfer failed");
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(IERC20 token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = address(token).call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount)
        );
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "TransferFrom failed");
    }

    function _pullTokenXExact(address tokenX, address from, uint256 amount) internal {
        uint256 balBefore = IERC20(tokenX).balanceOf(address(this));
        _safeTransferFrom(IERC20(tokenX), from, address(this), amount);
        uint256 received = IERC20(tokenX).balanceOf(address(this)) - balBefore;
        require(received == amount, "Token takes fee on transfer");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Constants & storage
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    IERC20 public constant USDC = IERC20(0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174);
    IERC20 public constant DAI  = IERC20(0x8f3Cf7ad23Cd3CaDbD9735AFf958023239c6A063);
    address public constant FEE_RECIPIENT = 0x1c4E583e380E1366298B34eFF8D000ef1e98bb46;

    uint256 public constant VIRTUAL_RESERVE = 10000 * 10**18;
    uint256 public constant REFERRAL_PERCENT = 1;
    uint256 public constant PROJECT_PERCENT  = 1;
    uint256 public constant PERCENT_DENOMINATOR = 100;

    address public immutable admin;
    address public router;

    mapping(address => bool) public allowedToken;
    mapping(address => address) public tokenCreator;

    mapping(address => address) public referrer;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refCount;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refBalanceUSDC18;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refBalanceDAI18;

    uint256 public projectFeeUSDC18;
    uint256 public projectFeeDAI18;

    struct Pool {
        address tokenX;
        uint256 reserveX;
        uint256 virtualY;
        uint256 realUSDC18;
        uint256 realDAI18;
        bool exists;
    }

    mapping(address => Pool) public poolX1;
    mapping(address => Pool) public poolX2;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Events
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    event PoolCreated(address indexed tokenX, uint256 reserveX, uint256 virtualY, uint8 poolType);
    event SwapExecuted(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed tokenX,
        uint8 poolType,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 priceBefore,
        uint256 priceAfter
    );
    event ReservesUpdated(address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 reserveX, uint256 realUSDC18, uint256 realDAI18);
    event PriceUpdated(address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 price);
    event UserTrade(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, bool isBuy, uint256 volumeUSD);
    event FeeCollected(address indexed tokenFee, uint8 fromPool, uint8 toPool, uint256 feeAmount, uint256 xBought);

    event ReferralSet(address indexed user, address indexed referrer);
    event ReferralReward(address indexed referrer, address indexed user, address token, uint256 amount18);
    event ReferralClaimed(address indexed referrer, uint256 usdcPaid, uint256 daiPaid);
    event ProjectFeeAccrued(address token, uint256 amount18);
    event ProjectFeeWithdrawn(address token, address to, uint256 amount18);

    event TokenAllowed(address indexed token);
    event TokenDisallowed(address indexed token);
    event RouterUpdated(address indexed router);
    event TokenReceivedFromRouter(
        address indexed token,
        address indexed creator,
        uint256 totalAmount,
        uint256 toPoolX1,
        uint256 toPoolX2
    );

    constructor() {
        admin = msg.sender;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Admin
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function setRouter(address _router) external onlyAdmin {
        require(_router != address(0), "zero router");
        router = _router;
        emit RouterUpdated(_router);
    }

    function allowToken(address token) external onlyAdmin {
        _require18Decimals(token);
        allowedToken[token] = true;
        emit TokenAllowed(token);
    }

    function disallowToken(address token) external onlyAdmin {
        require(allowedToken[token], "not allowed");
        allowedToken[token] = false;
        emit TokenDisallowed(token);
    }

    function _require18Decimals(address token) internal view {
        require(token != address(0), "zero token");
        require(token != address(USDC) && token != address(DAI), "stablecoin not allowed");
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("decimals()"));
        require(ok && data.length >= 32, "no decimals()");
        require(abi.decode(data, (uint256)) == 18, "token must have 18 decimals");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Referral
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function setReferrer(address _ref) external {
        require(_ref != address(0), "zero ref");
        require(_ref != msg.sender, "self ref");
        require(referrer[msg.sender] == address(0), "already set");
        referrer[msg.sender] = _ref;
        refCount[_ref] += 1;
        emit ReferralSet(msg.sender, _ref);
    }

    function claimReferralRewards() external nonReentrant {
        uint256 usdcAmt18 = refBalanceUSDC18[msg.sender];
        uint256 daiAmt18 = refBalanceDAI18[msg.sender];
        require(usdcAmt18 > 0 || daiAmt18 > 0, "nothing to claim");

        refBalanceUSDC18[msg.sender] = 0;
        refBalanceDAI18[msg.sender] = 0;

        uint256 usdcPaid;
        uint256 daiPaid;
        if (usdcAmt18 > 0) {
            usdcPaid = usdcAmt18 / 10**12;
            if (usdcPaid > 0) _safeTransfer(USDC, msg.sender, usdcPaid);
        }
        if (daiAmt18 > 0) {
            daiPaid = daiAmt18;
            _safeTransfer(DAI, msg.sender, daiPaid);
        }
        emit ReferralClaimed(msg.sender, usdcPaid, daiPaid);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Project fee withdrawal
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function withdrawProjectFee(address token, address to) external nonReentrant onlyAdmin {
        require(to != address(0), "zero to");
        if (token == address(USDC)) {
            uint256 amt18 = projectFeeUSDC18;
            require(amt18 > 0, "no USDC fee");
            projectFeeUSDC18 = 0;
            _safeTransfer(USDC, to, amt18 / 10**12);
            emit ProjectFeeWithdrawn(token, to, amt18);
        } else if (token == address(DAI)) {
            uint256 amt18 = projectFeeDAI18;
            require(amt18 > 0, "no DAI fee");
            projectFeeDAI18 = 0;
            _safeTransfer(DAI, to, amt18);
            emit ProjectFeeWithdrawn(token, to, amt18);
        } else {
            revert("unsupported token");
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Router integration
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function onTokenReceived(address token, address creator, uint256 amount) external {
        require(msg.sender == router, "only router");
        require(token != address(0), "zero token");
        require(creator != address(0), "zero creator");

        uint256 balance = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
        require(balance >= amount && balance > 0, "bad balance");
        _setupPoolsFromBalance(token, creator, balance);
    }

    function adminSetupPools(address token, address creator) external onlyAdmin {
        require(token != address(0), "zero token");
        require(creator != address(0), "zero creator");
        uint256 balance = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
        require(balance > 0, "no tokens");
        _setupPoolsFromBalance(token, creator, balance);
    }

    function _setupPoolsFromBalance(address token, address creator, uint256 balance) internal {
        require(!poolX1[token].exists && !poolX2[token].exists, "pools exist");
        require(balance >= 2, "too small");

        if (!allowedToken[token]) {
            _require18Decimals(token);
            allowedToken[token] = true;
            emit TokenAllowed(token);
        }

        uint256 halfX1 = balance / 2;
        uint256 halfX2 = balance - halfX1;

        poolX1[token] = Pool(token, halfX1, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 0, 0, true);
        poolX2[token] = Pool(token, halfX2, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 0, 0, true);
        tokenCreator[token] = creator;

        emit PoolCreated(token, halfX1, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 1);
        emit PoolCreated(token, halfX2, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 2);
        emit TokenReceivedFromRouter(token, creator, balance, halfX1, halfX2);

        _emitPoolState(token, true);
        _emitPoolState(token, false);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Manual pool creation
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function createPoolX1(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) external nonReentrant {
        require(allowedToken[tokenX], "Token not allowed");
        require(!poolX1[tokenX].exists, "Pool X1 exists");
        require(amountX > 0, "Amount must be > 0");
        _pullTokenXExact(tokenX, msg.sender, amountX);
        poolX1[tokenX] = Pool(tokenX, amountX, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 0, 0, true);
        emit PoolCreated(tokenX, amountX, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 1);
        _emitPoolState(tokenX, true);
    }

    function createPoolX2(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) external nonReentrant {
        require(allowedToken[tokenX], "Token not allowed");
        require(poolX1[tokenX].exists, "Pool X1 must exist");
        require(!poolX2[tokenX].exists, "Pool X2 exists");
        require(amountX > 0, "Amount must be > 0");
        _pullTokenXExact(tokenX, msg.sender, amountX);
        poolX2[tokenX] = Pool(tokenX, amountX, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 0, 0, true);
        emit PoolCreated(tokenX, amountX, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 2);
        _emitPoolState(tokenX, false);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Trading entry points
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function buyX1(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn) external nonReentrant onlyPoolX1(tokenX) {
        _buy(tokenX, tokenIn, amountIn, true);
    }

    function buyX2(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn) external nonReentrant onlyPoolX2(tokenX) {
        _buy(tokenX, tokenIn, amountIn, false);
    }

    function sellX1(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) external nonReentrant onlyPoolX1(tokenX) {
        _sell(tokenX, amountX, true);
    }

    function sellX2(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) external nonReentrant onlyPoolX2(tokenX) {
        _sell(tokenX, amountX, false);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helpers for buy/sell math
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _to18(address tokenIn, uint256 amount) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return tokenIn == address(USDC) ? amount * 10**12 : amount;
    }

    function _accrueInputFees(uint256 amountIn, address tokenIn) internal returns (uint256 netInput) {
        uint256 refFee = (amountIn * REFERRAL_PERCENT) / PERCENT_DENOMINATOR;
        uint256 projFee = (amountIn * PROJECT_PERCENT) / PERCENT_DENOMINATOR;
        _accrueTradeFees(tokenIn, refFee, projFee);
        netInput = amountIn - refFee - projFee;
    }

    function _maybeReinvest(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 fee18, bool usePoolX1) internal {
        if (fee18 == 0) return;
        Pool storage target = usePoolX1 ? poolX2[tokenX] : poolX1[tokenX];
        if (!target.exists) return;
        _reinvestFee(tokenX, tokenIn, fee18, target, !usePoolX1);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // BUY
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _buy(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, bool usePoolX1) internal {
        require(tokenIn == address(USDC) || tokenIn == address(DAI), "Only USDC or DAI");
        require(amountIn > 0, "Amount > 0");

        uint256 netInput = _accrueInputFees(amountIn, tokenIn);

        uint256 amountForPool18 = _to18(tokenIn, netInput);
        uint256 fee18 = amountForPool18 / 10;
        amountForPool18 -= fee18;

        Pool storage pool = usePoolX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        uint256 amountXOut = _swapBuyInPool(pool, tokenX, amountForPool18, tokenIn, amountIn, usePoolX1);

        _safeTransferFrom(IERC20(tokenIn), msg.sender, address(this), amountIn);
        _safeTransfer(IERC20(tokenX), msg.sender, amountXOut);

        emit UserTrade(msg.sender, tokenX, usePoolX1 ? 1 : 2, true, amountForPool18 + fee18);

        _maybeReinvest(tokenX, tokenIn, fee18, usePoolX1);

        _emitPoolState(tokenX, usePoolX1);
        _emitPrice(tokenX, usePoolX1);
    }

    function _swapBuyInPool(
        Pool storage pool,
        address tokenX,
        uint256 amountForPool18,
        address tokenIn,
        uint256 rawAmountIn,
        bool usePoolX1
    ) internal returns (uint256 amountXOut) {
        uint256 reserveX = pool.reserveX;
        uint256 oldY = pool.virtualY + pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18;
        uint256 newY = oldY + amountForPool18;
        uint256 newReserveX = (reserveX * oldY) / newY;
        amountXOut = reserveX - newReserveX;
        require(amountXOut > 0 && amountXOut < reserveX, "Insufficient liquidity");

        pool.reserveX = newReserveX;
        if (tokenIn == address(USDC)) {
            pool.realUSDC18 += amountForPool18;
        } else {
            pool.realDAI18 += amountForPool18;
        }

        uint256 priceBefore = reserveX > 0 ? oldY / reserveX : 0;
        uint256 priceAfter = newReserveX > 0 ? newY / newReserveX : 0;

        emit SwapExecuted(
            msg.sender,
            tokenX,
            usePoolX1 ? 1 : 2,
            true,
            rawAmountIn,
            amountXOut,
            priceBefore,
            priceAfter
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // SELL
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _sell(address tokenX, uint256 amountX, bool usePoolX1) internal {
        require(amountX > 0, "Amount > 0");

        Pool storage pool = usePoolX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        require(amountX < pool.reserveX, "Not enough X");

        uint256 stableOut18 = _swapSellInPool(pool, tokenX, amountX, usePoolX1);

        uint256 refFee18 = stableOut18 / 100;
        uint256 projFee18 = stableOut18 / 100;
        uint256 userOut18 = stableOut18 - refFee18 - projFee18;

        _pullTokenXExact(tokenX, msg.sender, amountX);

        _deductAndAccrueSellFees(pool, refFee18, projFee18);
        _payoutStable(pool, msg.sender, userOut18);

        emit UserTrade(msg.sender, tokenX, usePoolX1 ? 1 : 2, false, userOut18);

        _emitPoolState(tokenX, usePoolX1);
        _emitPrice(tokenX, usePoolX1);
    }

    function _swapSellInPool(
        Pool storage pool,
        address tokenX,
        uint256 amountX,
        bool usePoolX1
    ) internal returns (uint256 stableOut18) {
        uint256 reserveX = pool.reserveX;
        uint256 oldRealY = pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18;
        uint256 effectiveY = pool.virtualY + oldRealY;
        uint256 newReserveX = reserveX + amountX;
        uint256 newEffectiveY = (reserveX * effectiveY) / newReserveX;
        require(newEffectiveY > pool.virtualY, "No real stable left");

        uint256 newRealY = newEffectiveY - pool.virtualY;
        stableOut18 = oldRealY - newRealY;
        require(stableOut18 > 0 && stableOut18 <= oldRealY, "Invalid output");

        pool.reserveX = newReserveX;

        uint256 priceBefore = reserveX > 0 ? effectiveY / reserveX : 0;
        uint256 priceAfter = newReserveX > 0 ? newEffectiveY / newReserveX : 0;

        emit SwapExecuted(
            msg.sender,
            tokenX,
            usePoolX1 ? 1 : 2,
            false,
            amountX,
            stableOut18,
            priceBefore,
            priceAfter
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Payouts
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _payoutStable(Pool storage pool, address user, uint256 stableOut18) internal {
        uint256 usdc18 = pool.realUSDC18;
        if (stableOut18 <= usdc18) {
            pool.realUSDC18 = usdc18 - stableOut18;
            _safeTransfer(USDC, user, stableOut18 / 10**12);
        } else {
            pool.realUSDC18 = 0;
            _safeTransfer(USDC, user, usdc18 / 10**12);
            uint256 remaining = stableOut18 - usdc18;
            require(pool.realDAI18 >= remaining, "Not enough DAI");
            pool.realDAI18 -= remaining;
            _safeTransfer(DAI, user, remaining);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Fee accrual
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _accrueTradeFees(address tokenIn, uint256 refFeeIn, uint256 projFeeIn) internal {
        address ref = referrer[msg.sender];

        if (tokenIn == address(USDC)) {
            uint256 projFee18 = projFeeIn * 10**12;
            if (projFee18 > 0) {
                projectFeeUSDC18 += projFee18;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), projFee18);
            }
            if (refFeeIn > 0) {
                uint256 refFee18 = refFeeIn * 10**12;
                if (ref != address(0)) {
                    refBalanceUSDC18[ref] += refFee18;
                    emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(USDC), refFee18);
                } else {
                    projectFeeUSDC18 += refFee18;
                    emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), refFee18);
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (projFeeIn > 0) {
                projectFeeDAI18 += projFeeIn;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), projFeeIn);
            }
            if (refFeeIn > 0) {
                if (ref != address(0)) {
                    refBalanceDAI18[ref] += refFeeIn;
                    emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(DAI), refFeeIn);
                } else {
                    projectFeeDAI18 += refFeeIn;
                    emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), refFeeIn);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    function _deductAndAccrueSellFees(Pool storage pool, uint256 refFee18, uint256 projFee18) internal {
        if (projFee18 > 0) {
            (uint256 projUSDC, uint256 projDAI) = _deductStableFromPool(pool, projFee18);
            if (projUSDC > 0) {
                projectFeeUSDC18 += projUSDC;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), projUSDC);
            }
            if (projDAI > 0) {
                projectFeeDAI18 += projDAI;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), projDAI);
            }
        }
        if (refFee18 == 0) return;
        (uint256 refUSDC, uint256 refDAI) = _deductStableFromPool(pool, refFee18);
        address ref = referrer[msg.sender];
        if (ref != address(0)) {
            if (refUSDC > 0) {
                refBalanceUSDC18[ref] += refUSDC;
                emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(USDC), refUSDC);
            }
            if (refDAI > 0) {
                refBalanceDAI18[ref] += refDAI;
                emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(DAI), refDAI);
            }
        } else {
            if (refUSDC > 0) {
                projectFeeUSDC18 += refUSDC;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), refUSDC);
            }
            if (refDAI > 0) {
                projectFeeDAI18 += refDAI;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), refDAI);
            }
        }
    }

    function _deductStableFromPool(Pool storage pool, uint256 amount18)
        internal
        returns (uint256 usdcPart, uint256 daiPart)
    {
        uint256 usdcBal = pool.realUSDC18;
        if (amount18 <= usdcBal) {
            pool.realUSDC18 = usdcBal - amount18;
            return (amount18, 0);
        }
        pool.realUSDC18 = 0;
        uint256 remaining = amount18 - usdcBal;
        require(pool.realDAI18 >= remaining, "Not enough DAI for fees");
        pool.realDAI18 -= remaining;
        return (usdcBal, remaining);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Reinvest
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _reinvestFee(
        address tokenX,
        address tokenFee,
        uint256 fee18,
        Pool storage target,
        bool targetIsX1
    ) internal {
        uint256 oldEffectiveY = target.virtualY + target.realUSDC18 + target.realDAI18;
        uint256 newY = oldEffectiveY + fee18;
        uint256 newReserveX = (target.reserveX * oldEffectiveY) / newY;
        uint256 amountX = target.reserveX - newReserveX;
        require(amountX > 0 && amountX < target.reserveX, "Reinvest insufficient");

        target.reserveX = newReserveX;
        if (tokenFee == address(USDC)) {
            target.realUSDC18 += fee18;
        } else {
            target.realDAI18 += fee18;
        }

        _safeTransfer(IERC20(tokenX), FEE_RECIPIENT, amountX);

        emit FeeCollected(
            tokenFee,
            targetIsX1 ? 2 : 1,
            targetIsX1 ? 1 : 2,
            fee18,
            amountX
        );
        _emitPoolState(tokenX, targetIsX1);
        _emitPrice(tokenX, targetIsX1);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Emit helpers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _emitPoolState(address tokenX, bool isX1) internal {
        Pool storage p = isX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        emit ReservesUpdated(tokenX, isX1 ? 1 : 2, p.reserveX, p.realUSDC18, p.realDAI18);
    }

    function _emitPrice(address tokenX, bool isX1) internal {
        Pool storage p = isX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        if (p.reserveX > 0) {
            uint256 price = (p.virtualY + p.realUSDC18 + p.realDAI18) / p.reserveX;
            emit PriceUpdated(tokenX, isX1 ? 1 : 2, price);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Views
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function getPoolBalances(address tokenX, bool isX1)
        external
        view
        returns (uint256 usdc, uint256 dai, uint256 total18)
    {
        Pool storage p = isX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        require(p.exists, "Pool does not exist");
        usdc = p.realUSDC18 / 10**12;
        dai = p.realDAI18;
        total18 = p.realUSDC18 + p.realDAI18;
    }

    function getTokenPrice(address tokenX, bool isX1) external view returns (uint256 price18) {
        Pool storage p = isX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        require(p.exists && p.reserveX > 0, "Invalid pool");
        price18 = (p.virtualY + p.realUSDC18 + p.realDAI18) / p.reserveX;
    }

    function getTotalLiquidity(address tokenX)
        external
        view
        returns (uint256 liquidityX1, uint256 liquidityX2, uint256 total)
    {
        if (poolX1[tokenX].exists) {
            liquidityX1 = poolX1[tokenX].virtualY + poolX1[tokenX].realUSDC18 + poolX1[tokenX].realDAI18;
        }
        if (poolX2[tokenX].exists) {
            liquidityX2 = poolX2[tokenX].virtualY + poolX2[tokenX].realUSDC18 + poolX2[tokenX].realDAI18;
        }
        total = liquidityX1 + liquidityX2;
    }

    function getActualStableBalances() external view returns (uint256 usdcBalance, uint256 daiBalance) {
        usdcBalance = USDC.balanceOf(address(this));
        daiBalance = DAI.balanceOf(address(this));
    }

    function getPoolState(address tokenX, bool isX1)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 reserveX,
            uint256 virtualY,
            uint256 usdc,
            uint256 dai,
            uint256 price,
            uint256 liquidity
        )
    {
        Pool storage p = isX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        require(p.exists, "Pool does not exist");
        reserveX = p.reserveX;
        virtualY = p.virtualY;
        usdc = p.realUSDC18 / 10**12;
        dai = p.realDAI18;
        liquidity = p.virtualY + p.realUSDC18 + p.realDAI18;
        price = reserveX > 0 ? liquidity / reserveX : 0;
    }

    function getPoolX1(address tokenX)
        external
        view
        returns (uint256 reserveX, uint256 virtualY, uint256 realUSDC18, uint256 realDAI18)
    {
        Pool memory p = poolX1[tokenX];
        return (p.reserveX, p.virtualY, p.realUSDC18, p.realDAI18);
    }

    function getPoolX2(address tokenX)
        external
        view
        returns (uint256 reserveX, uint256 virtualY, uint256 realUSDC18, uint256 realDAI18)
    {
        Pool memory p = poolX2[tokenX];
        return (p.reserveX, p.virtualY, p.realUSDC18, p.realDAI18);
    }

    function getReferrer(address user) external view returns (address) {
        return referrer[user];
    }

    function getReferralBalance(address ref) external view returns (uint256 usdc18, uint256 dai18) {
        return (refBalanceUSDC18[ref], refBalanceDAI18[ref]);
    }

    function getProjectFeeBalance() external view returns (uint256 usdc18, uint256 dai18) {
        return (projectFeeUSDC18, projectFeeDAI18);
    }
}
